messages:
Omar Haddad: hey folks! excited to start today as a data infra engineer. quick setup q: who handles laptop pickup and VPN access? also fun fact: i used to race radio-controlled cars.

Linh Tran: welcome Omar :tada: Laptop/pickup is People Ops (floor 2). For VPN, ping eng-security or reply here and i'll route it. i'll add you to #eng-data and book a quick intro with the team.

Ravi Patel: hey Omar 44b i'm your onboarding buddy. If you need a VPN cert, i can open the request. also fyi our dev image is redwood-data-dev-1. Bring RC-car pics to the slack thread! :car: 

Zoe Kim: hi Omar! i'm on eng-platform. for SSH keys, drop your public key in the secure request form: https://go/redwood/ssh-keys. i'll check infra perms once VPN is live.

Omar Haddad: thanks everyone! DM'd Ravi my manager approval and uploaded my pubkey. will stop by People Ops after standup. also attaching an old race pic later :)

OnboardingBot: Welcome Omar Haddad! You've been added to: #eng-data, #eng-platform, #new-hires. Onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood.com/checklists/1799991111. Quick verify command to test access:
``nssh omar@jumpbox.redwood
/opt/redwood/bin/onboard-verify --quick
```

Linh Tran: great! see you at the 3pm team intro. :wave:
